demo_caption: This is raak itself, not a screenshot. Search both projects, or open a task.
highlights.text_1: Matches show up in each project at the same time. Put a minus in front of a word to leave it out.
highlights.text_2: Start, finish, deliver, review, accept. One click moves the work along, right where you see it.
highlights.text_3: Tasks are stored locally for offline search and direct updates. Changes are synced as you get back online.
highlights.title_2: Every card shows its next step
pricing.text_1: Ideal if you are just getting started.
pricing.text_2: For those that have multiple projects in production.
showcase.from_cella: Of all code is from Cella
text_1: Raak is a fast, high-density issue tracker designed for small teams that manage multiple projects simultaneously.
text_2: Most issue trackers make you navigate between projects, boards, and issue pages. Raak keeps everything in a single page view.
title_1:
Every issue. All projects.
One page.
title_2: An issue tracker that eliminates navigation
